judged_text: embed.js throws TypeError (appendChild on null) when the publisher's page has no element with id 'discourse-comments', and the throw also prevents the resize postMessage listener from ever being attached. A publisher who misconfigures the snippet gets a silent console error and no comments, with no diagnostic pointing at the missing container.

adjudication.rationale: In new `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the script does `var comments = document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then unconditionally calls `comments.appendChild(iframe);`. If the publisher page lacks an element with id `discourse-comments`, `comments` is `null` and this will throw a `TypeError`. Because the exception occurs before `window.addEventListener('message', postMessageReceived, false);`, the resize postMessage listener is never attached, matching the finding.
